build: The two new modules were built from source on Linux with Lake, on top of a build of every project module made in the same environment, against the Mathlib cache for the pinned revision. Lake checks source hashes before reusing a compiled module, and every project source in the import closure other than the two new modules is byte-identical to the base checkpoint. The new modules compiled without warnings.

project_closure.note: Every project module the root imports, directly or transitively, with the SHA-256 of its source at the proof checkpoint. Two are new; the others are unchanged from the base checkpoint and were built in the same environment.
